newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.

text.p: High sulphur Russian straight-run fuel oil prices were steady on Monday following a little refiner buying at the end of last week, traders said.
A trader was heard to have sold on Friday an E-4 cargo, sailing on the Blue Star, to an ARA player at around $110.50 cif. The cargo contained around 1.5 percent water.
Another trader sold an E-4 cargo on Thursday, loading in Klaipeda late last week and containing a maximum of two percent water, to a refiner at around $1 over the mean/mean/mean of published quotes.
Low water E-4 cargoes were assessed at around m/m/m +$4-$5 cif NWE.
